name: EdgeDesk Simulator — MLB correlated season and postseason simulation
registry_sql: NOT GENERATED: simulator/src/research/build_registry_sql.ts generates the registry SQL for one model (registration.json, SIM-NFL-SEASON) and names it in public.sim_config; extending it to a second model is follow-up work. This file is the preregistration of record until then.
hypothesis: Simulating the remaining MLB season and postseason 100,000 times from the served MLB lab brain (mlb/history, v1.1.0), with persistent club and starting-pitcher strength offsets calibrated on 2012-2023 frozen forecasts and starters Projected from a measured rotation model, produces calibrated probabilities of division titles, postseason berths, byes, pennants and the World Series.
objective: Calibrated season-outcome probabilities from any as-of date of an MLB-2022-format season, as a research comparison against futures prices where EdgeDesk captures them; never a recommendation.
primary_metric: Brier score of win_division and make_playoffs probabilities on the holdout seasons at as-of stages 40, 81, 120 and 140 club games, pooled; then log loss with probabilities clipped to [max(1e-6, 0.5/N), 1 - that].
unit: One club-season-outcome at one as-of stage (30 clubs x outcome x stage x season); the stages of one season share outcomes: every interval is a season-cluster bootstrap.
baseline: The same simulator with sigma_team = sigma_sp = 0 (the frozen model's game probabilities only); and, where owned, same-time Kalshi futures reference prices (none owned).
training_window: sigma_team, sigma_sp and the replacement level calibrated on 2012-2023 frozen forecasts (2020 and 2024 left out); rotation uncertainty fitted on 2018-2023 (simulator/data/mlb_rotation_study.json); the game model is the served one.
validation_window: 2022, 2023 and 2025 as-of replays (simulator/data/mlb_backtest.json), descriptive only: 2022 and 2023 are in-sample for the sigmas, 2025 is one season.
holdout_window: Seasons 2026 (from its first live snapshot), 2027 and 2028, each evaluated once after its World Series.

machine.window_note: [from, to): dates of the seasons inside each window

minimum_sample.note: Below three holdout seasons the record is reported descriptively and no result row is written. No MLB futures quotes are captured; until enough are, the market criteria are NOT EVALUABLE and the model cannot pass.

promotion_criteria.decision_rule: passed = true only if every criterion below holds on the holdout. A criterion that cannot be evaluated is not met. Passing makes the model eligible; a person promotes it through a validation report. Software tests passing is never evidence for any criterion.

criteria.rule: Pooled Brier (win_division, make_playoffs; stages 40/81/120/140; holdout seasons) of the production simulator <= the sigma = 0 simulator's, with the season-cluster bootstrap 95% upper bound of (production - sigma0) below +0.002.
Calibration slope of make_playoffs probabilities (logistic regression of outcome on logit p, holdout) within [0.8, 1.2] and calibration in the large within 0.02.
Brier no worse than same-time Kalshi futures reference prices on at least 200 matched outcomes (NOT EVALUABLE until captured).
Positive mean closing-line value of flagged futures at the executable ask, fees verified, on at least 100 flags with observed closes (NOT EVALUABLE until captured).

forking_paths: Choices made before any holdout season: the rotation set (last five distinct starters), the regular-season rule (oldest rested), the postseason rule (best rested of the four best by s; chosen on 2012-2023 one-step accuracy), the spot-start conventions, the stage grid and the sigma grid. Any change to these is a new version, re-registered before the next holdout evaluation.
limitations: The served game model's moneyline does not beat Elo in its walk-forward record and showed no skill over 494 postseason games (2012-2025).
Bullpen usage and fatigue, lineups, platoons, weather and injuries beyond rotation departures are not modelled.
Projected starters: the next start named correctly 63% of the time in 2018-2023, a postseason start 52%.
The postseason carries the stage-140 sigma, not calibrated after the regular season.
